shortDescription.default: Nonna — the trattoria's back office as a Copilot agent with a live desk UI.

longDescription.default: Nonna runs the books, the rota and the purchase orders of the Copilot Pizza Factory's trattoria — and she lives entirely inside Microsoft 365. Ask about the rota, report a sick call, review purchase orders waiting for a signature, or check the invoices, and Copilot renders her desk as a living UI. PREVIEW: built on SharePoint Framework 1.24 Copilot components.

features.title: nonna-copilot-app Feature
features.description: Activates the Nonna's Desk Copilot component and the Nonna declarative agent.
